See, he worked in a young tuxedo with John Cashman. Oh, yeah, lately, huh? Oh, I don't know him. You know, I got a whole lot of these school boys coming out now. I got a little fella, Victor Spender's son. He's good, yeah, but Vic never really get caught up there. He had his name, eh? He ain't never really get caught up there. He's a child. He's a good reader, but he couldn't play.
Vic Dispenza. I don't know him.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Ask him who played with John Cashman. I said, who played with John Cashman then? I said, I don't know who played with John, uh.

ctx.x: No. No, he didn't have no trumpet. When they got rid of us, they got, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, Ted Howard. He didn't stay that long. He couldn't make it, you know. He didn't make it, you know. He looked up on, sitting out there and, by the way, you know, he got to have to let us go. Uh, uh, uh. Ask him who played with John Cashman. I said, who played with John Cashman then? I said, I don't know who played with John, uh.
Then? Then, not now, then. Huh?
